blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 NCGTC Tweaks MFI Credit Guarantee Norms (CGSMFI 2.0) to Boost Scheme Utilisation. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Restructured rules ensure credit guarantee cover reaches lower-tier microfinance institutions.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
The **National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Ltd. (NCGTC)** modified allocation rules under **CGSMFI 2.0**.
**Mandatory Bank Allocation:** Commercial banks must lend at least **15%** of their total ₹20,000 crore corpus to **small- and mid-size MFIs** (up from 5% and 10%).
**Sanction Cap:** Maximum bank loan capped at **20% of AUM (total market value of assets under management)** of NBFC-MFIs and MFIs.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**Lender Size Caps:** Max loan capped at **₹100 crore** (small MFIs), **₹200 crore** (medium MFIs), and **₹1,000 crore** (large MFIs).
**MFI Classification by AUM (total market value of assets under management):** Small MFI (<₹500 crore AUM (total market value of assets under management)), Medium MFI (₹500–₹2,000 crore AUM), Large MFI (>₹2,000 crore AUM).
**Scheme Corpus:** Guarantees loans up to **₹20,000 crore** (wholly owned by Govt of India).
Small MFI limit (<₹500 cr AUM (total market value of assets under management)) vs Medium MFI limit (₹500–₹2,000 cr AUM (total market value of assets under management)) vs 15% bank lending pool quota.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on nodal central ministry, total financial outlay, funding split ratio, beneficiary eligibility, and target milestone year.
